profile.headline: Software Engineer, Optimist
profile.summary: Skilled, driven, and teachable. I currently work mainly on mobile applications, but I pick up new technologies quickly, and always appreciate the opportunity to do so. With software development as my chosen career path, I'm always looking for interesting platforms that I feel I could work well on. I'm confident I'd be a good addition to any development team, and I look forward to meeting yours!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Wayfair, I was part of the Tailoring side of things, which helps to tweak the Wayfair experience to suit different kinds of shoppers. In my case, my team tailored the experience to customers who are shopping for Business needs. I put in work that helped to expand the Wayfair Professional program expand overseas to the UK, and helped to implement a brand-new, native "Get Help" flow, which contributed to a significant decrease in order-related calls to our customer service center.

I was also a member of Wayfair's iOS Criticals team, which supports weekly releases of the app. In collaboration with other engineers I helped to ensure that release candidates are stable, and that any bugs which would block the release were dealt with in a timely manor.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Developer - HeyGamer
June 2019 - July 2019

An iOS application meant to connect gamers for that oh-so-illusive Couch Co-Op experience. Created as a student project, this app was written in Swift, and utilizes CoreLocation, MapKit, Cloud Firestore, and RESTful API calls, comprised of basic social media features such as profile creation and management and user-to-user messaging.

positions.title: Livestream Technician
positions.description: Working as a livestream technician and producer, providing high quality broadcasts for competitive gaming and eSports events. Primarily operating within the Super Smash Bros. community. Technologies included typically involve Xsplit, OBS, and a wide array of audio-video equipment.

positions.title: Remote Support Technician
positions.description: Responsible for assisting end-users with the operation of a proprietary, Linux-based operating system. Support requests were handled through a combination of phone calls and VNC sessions for more hands on troubleshooting.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
Worked as the lead developer on one project within the company. Responsible for design and development of gameplay systems and playable content, as well as story scenarios.

Technologies: Game Maker Studio 2, GML, Atlassian Sourcetree
